items.title_en: Only One Country On Earth Still Has Both Wild Lions And Tigers, Do You Know Which?
items.title_zh: 地球上只有一个国家同时拥有野生狮子和老虎，你知道是哪一个吗？
items.summary_en: From the dry forests of Gujarat to the jungles of Central India, the country remains the last shared home of two of the world’s most iconic big cats.
items.summary_zh: 从古吉拉特邦的干燥森林到印度中部的丛林，这个国家仍然是世界上最具标志性的两种大型猫科动物最后的共同家园。

items.title_en: 'Majnu Bhai Is The OG Artist': Viral Goat-On-A-Donkey Video Reminds Fans Of Iconic Scene From Welcome Nearl
items.title_zh: “Majnu Bhai 是 OG 艺术家”：山羊骑驴的视频让粉丝想起《Welcome Nearl》中的标志性场景
items.summary_en: A viral video of a goat standing on a donkey while eating leaves has left Welcome fans in splits, with many comparing the scene to Majnu Bhai's iconic painting
items.summary_zh: 一段山羊站在驴子上吃树叶的视频在网上疯传，这让《Welcome》的粉丝们意见不一，许多人将这一场景与 Majnu Bhai 的标志性画作进行了比较。
